purpose: Replace the causally disconnected shallow local negative control with a parameter-matched local circuit whose light cones cover every held-out distance.

local_architecture.sharing_rule: All occurrences on nearest-neighbour bond (i,i+1) share SU(4) group i.
local_architecture.causal_cone_rule: Backward causal cones must overlap for every open-chain pair at distance r>=8.

statistics.pooled_estimand: Equal-field-weight mean paired difference over the three fixed fields.

guardrails: The code must verify minimal light-cone depth and all held-out-pair coverage before training.
LOCAL_LC225 is a local-circuit control and is not called an MPS.
The local control has more physical gates than MERA; gate exposure is reported rather than hidden.
No result is removed or rerun with changed settings.
